title: GIMAT v1.0: streaming framework for leakage-free ten-day streamflow forecasting
description: Code, conformance tests and replay harness for GIMAT v1.0 and the P-stream v1.0 evaluation protocol. Every quantity emitted at step t is computed from the information available at t; compliance is checked by four mechanical tests. Accompanies a manuscript submitted to Geoscientific Model Development.
